name: Hierarchy
summary: A single-root hierarchy drawn as connected pairs of rounded cards.
description: Show a classification or work breakdown with 1 to 8 short entries. Use one list: the first entry is the level-zero root and each child sets its zero-based level. Keep parents before children and do not skip a depth. Unsupported forests, jumps, descriptions or long labels retain the complete list with a finding instead of changing relationships or shrinking text.
